result.summary: Found 1 major issue: a duplicated restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel.

issues.description: Two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards appear side-by-side in the 'Fastest near you' carousel, with the same image, 15-25 min delivery time, name, and €0.90 delivery fee, making the carousel look duplicated/broken.
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate restaurant results before rendering the carousel and replace the second card with the next distinct restaurant.
